base:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-end anime game room environment concept, single standalone landscape image, aspect 16:9. Design an expansive SINGLE square room INSIDE a custom transparent skeleton desktop PC case, scaled as an avatar's inhabitable studio. Architectural shell only; no avatar or furnishings yet. Style: sophisticated clean anime game background with polished stylized 3D construction, soft cel-like shading, delicate contours, satin surfaces, restrained reflections. Matches an anime avatar wearing charcoal/white oversized techwear and cyan/lavender trim, not realistic photography and not cute chibi toy plastic.
SPATIAL MASTER, maintain for all later views: square floor roughly 9 x 9 meters, wall height 3.5m, avatar would be 1.6m (do NOT draw avatar). Broad unobstructed center and continuous floor, no partitions or raised central stage. PC case architectural frame: modest bevels, precision mounting screws, lower plinth, four corner uprights, slim roof perimeter rails. Two opaque adjacent service walls NORTH and WEST; two adjacent full height transparent glass walls SOUTH and EAST. North wall has a broad EMPTY recessed rectangular service panel centered, paired small EMPTY circular capped mounting plates near its upper WEST end for two future removable fans (not actual fans). West wall has three tall narrow flush maintenance panels near NORTH end and fine vertical heatsink-like trim only at edges. South glass has a narrow offset access panel near EAST end. East glass is uninterrupted clear panoramic glass. Roof center is transparent glass, visualized removed in overview. Room is a spacious airy residential-scale environment, not a corridor, spaceship cockpit, data center or actual hardware-filled PC.
Motherboard-inspired continuous floor: fine dense clusters of inlaid PCB traces running parallel and turning 45 or 90 degrees, branching gracefully to circular vias and small flush rectangular pads. Many thin trace paths on perimeter and moderate traces across center, no massive center CPU socket. Traces physically recessed/flush so people can walk. North/west walls repeat a lighter amount of vertical PCB traces. Static soft emissive cyan, ice blue, lavender with occasional magenta and restrained mint accents, multicolor light inside diffused channels like flexible RGB silicone neon. Glow restrained and locally contained, beautiful, not a blown-out rainbow or overbright haze.
Reserve open areas along edges for future separate layers: battery-bed, storage-bookcase, RAM desk/chair, undecided CPU/GPU, miniature radio tower, wall clock, two fans, monitor with external wall cable, incoming cable connecting to floor. DO NOT DRAW ANY OF THESE, no beds, desks, chairs, shelves, actual electronic chips, clock, fans, monitor, towers, loose cables, people, UI, text, logos, watermark. Flat subtle capped attachment points only. No plants needed. Outside glass: neutral quiet cool gradient, faint depth, no unrelated landscape or extra rooms.

WHITE MATERIAL VARIANT: pearl white powder-coated aluminum frame, soft ivory-white motherboard floor and wall panels, light gray recessed joints, near-clear barely blue glass, pearl metallic edge details; well-lit softly with enough shadows to show geometry. Glass roof center removed in visualization, front south/east panes almost invisible so all interior can be seen, no frame across image center. Back NORTH wall on image right, WEST wall on image left. Keep case silhouette complete including corner frame and small feet. Render one image only, not contact sheet.
blackOverview: Use case: lighting-weather / material color variant of attached MASTER environment concept. Create exactly the SAME room, same camera, same geometry, framing, glass, screw positions, 3 narrow wall panels, large wall panel, pair of small blank circular mounting plates, all PCB trace routing and pads, EMPTY floor. Change ONLY white frame/floor/wall materials to rich charcoal and graphite black, satin black anodized aluminum, dark graphite PCB substrate, subtly lighter dark gray service panels. Glass stays clear, never opaque or mirror-black. Make the cyan, ice blue, lavender, pink traces legible against black with gentle emissive glow, restrained hint of mint, no overall purple fog. Use enough soft neutral illumination that dark panels and open floor remain readable and an anime avatar in black techwear would be silhouetted well by pale cyan ambient fill. Stylized anime 3D background quality matching original. Preserve all architectural features exactly. No avatar, furniture, hardware components, fan blades, screens, cables, UI, labels or logos. Single landscape 16:9 image, OVERVIEW, not collage.

views.white: Use case: stylized-concept, camera transformation of the attached MASTER room. Render a SINGLE clean landscape 16:9 interior image from INSIDE this exact same room, changing ONLY camera view. This is a horizontal eye-level room inspection camera, NOT an isometric overview. Camera height about 1.55m in the 3.5m tall room, level horizon, perfectly vertical verticals, broad 80-90 degree horizontal field of view, no fisheye, comfortable view of floor and ceiling edge with spacious scale. No cutaway exterior foreground or dollhouse feet: viewer is inside. Room square 9 x 9m. Do not redesign/mirror/rearrange architecture. MASTER uses two solid NORTH/WEST walls and two clear EAST/SOUTH walls. North: broad rectangular inset service panel centered with 2 small round blank capped fan mount covers to its WEST side. West: THREE narrow tall service panels and ribbed edge accents. South and east: full clear glass; south has subtle access panel near east. Slim overhead frame and clear glass ceiling, not opaque heavy sci-fi roof. Keep master floor PCB trace layout, corner detail, ceiling perimeter, materials and restrained cyan/lavender/pink glow. Sophisticated softly shaded anime game 3D background, no photorealistic noise. Spacious unobstructed floor for future avatar and separate furniture components. Do not add avatar, furniture, appliances, physical computer chips, fans, clocks, cables, screens, UI, typography, labels, logos, or props. Clear neutral cool gradient exterior beyond glass. Pearl-white master palette. CAMERA DIRECTION: Camera just INSIDE SOUTH-EAST corner, looking diagonally NORTH-WEST. Facing the two opaque service walls: WEST wall with THREE narrow vertical maintenance panels appears LEFT; NORTH wall with wide rectangular panel and paired small upper circular blank covers appears RIGHT. Their shared NORTH-WEST junction is near image middle. Broad open floor in foreground. This is the interior horizontal counterpart of the master overview.
